churches.assessment: Bethlehem Baptist Church — formerly pastored by John Piper. Now led by Kenny Stokes (Lead Pastor) and Jason Meyer (Pastor for Preaching and Vision). Strong Reformed Baptist theology inherited from Piper era. Solid conservative evangelical church.
